```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(rvest)
library(p8105.datasets)

options(
  ggplot2.continuous.colour = "viridis",
  ggplot2.continuous.fill = "viridis"
)

scale_colour_discrete = scale_colour_viridis_d
scale_fill_discrete = scale_fill_viridis_d
```

```{r}
string_vec = c("my", "name", "is", "lina")

str_detect(string_vec, "lina")

str_replace(string_vec, "my", "My")
```

```{r}
string_vec = c(
  "i think we all rule for participating",
  "i think i have been caught",
  "i think this will be quite fun actually",
  "it will be fun, i think"
  )

str_detect(string_vec, "^i think")
```
^ indicates the beginning of the line
$ indicates the end of the sentence

```{r}
string_vec = c(
  "Time for a Pumpkin Spice Latte!",
  "went to the #pumpkinpatch last weekend",
  "Pumpkin Pie is obviously the best pie",
  "SMASHING PUMPKINS -- LIVE IN CONCERT!!"
  )

str_detect(string_vec,"[Pp]umpkin")
```
[] either caps

```{r}
string_vec = c(
  '7th inning stretch',
  '1st half soon to begin. Texas won the toss.',
  'she is 5 feet 4 inches tall',
  '3AM - cant sleep :('
  )

str_detect(string_vec, "^[0-9][a-zA-Z]")
## finds a digit followed by a letter at the beginning of the phrase
```

```{r}
string_vec = c(
  'Its 7:11 in the evening',
  'want to go to 7-11?',
  'my flight is AA711',
  'NetBios: scanning ip 203.167.114.66'
  )

str_detect(string_vec, "7.11")
```
X.XX dot matches anything

```{r}
string_vec = c(
  'The CI is [2, 5]',
  ':-]',
  ':-[',
  'I found the answer on pages [6-7]'
  )

str_detect(string_vec, "\\[")
```
brackets are used to define ranges, \\ indicates you want that actual character

## factors

```{r}
vec_sex = factor(c("male", "male", "female", "female"))

as.numeric(vec_sex)

vec_sex = fct_relevel(vec_sex, "male")
```
fct_revel tells it to switch the levels in reverse

## Import NSDUH

```{r}
nsduh_url = "https://www.samhsa.gov/data/sites/default/files/NSDUHsaeShortTermCHG2015/NSDUHsaeShortTermCHG2015.htm"
```

```{r}
marj_df = 
  read_html(nsduh_url) |> 
  html_table() |> 
  first() |>
  slice(-1) |> 
  select(-contains("P Value")) |> 
  pivot_longer(
    -State,
    names_to = "age_year",
    values_to = "prev"
  ) |> 
  separate(age_year, into = c("age", "year"), sep = "\\(") |> 
  mutate(
    year = str_replace(year, "\\)", ""),
    prev = str_replace(prev, "[a-c]", ""),
    prev = as.numeric(prev)
  )
```


Plot

```{r}
marj_df |> 
  filter(age == "12-17") |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = State, y=prev, color = year)) +
  geom_point()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))
```

Air bnb again
```{r}
data(nyc_airbnb)

nyc_airbnb |> 
  filter(neighbourhood_group == "Manhattan", price <1000) |> 
  mutate(neighbourhood = fct_reorder(neighbourhood, price)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = neighbourhood, y = price)) +
  geom_boxplot()+
  coord_flip()
```

## restaurant inspections

```{r}
data("rest_inspect")

rest_inspec =
  rest_inspec |> 
  rename(borough = boro)
```

Quick EDA
```{r}
rest_inspec |> 
  count(borough, grade) |> 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = grade, 
    values_from = n)
```

```{r}
rest_inspec =
  rest_inspec |>
  filter(borough != "0", 
         grade %in% c ("A", "B", "C"))
  rest_inspec |> 
  count(borough, grade) |> 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = grade, 
    values_from = n)
```


FIND PIZZA
```{r}
rest_inspec |>
  filter(str_detect(dba, "[Pp][Ii][Zz][Zz][Aa]")) |> 
  count(borough, grade) |> 
  summarize(n = n()) |> 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = grade, 
    values_from = n)
```

this is better
```{r}
rest_inspec |>
  mutate(dba = str_to_upper(dba)) |> 
  filter(str_detect(dba, "PIZZA")) |> 
  count(borough, grade) |> 
  summarize(n = n()) |> 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = grade, 
    values_from = n)
```

```{r}
rest_inspec |>
  mutate(borough = fct_infreq(borough)) |> 
  filter(str_detect(dba, "[Pp][Ii][Zz][Zz][Aa]")) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = borough, fill = grade)) +
  geom_bar()
```
